classification: adaptive engineering follow-up informed by v3; not a confirmatory experiment
purpose: Test high-fidelity serverless retrieval by retaining all 1024 canonical dimensions while compressing frozen document vectors from float32 to signed int8 and routing across static semantic shards.

lineage.observed_reason_for_change: fp16 browser parity passed but 256-dimensional truncation failed retrieval-preservation gates
lineage.adaptive_change: reduced_dimension changes from 256 to 1024; all other model, clustering and ranking choices remain fixed

fixed_design.prototype_sample_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus
fixed_design.document_quantization: symmetric signed int8 with fixed scale 127 after L2 normalization
fixed_design.cluster_training_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus

decision_rule.pass: Every gate passes with the fixed v4 design.
decision_rule.fail: Any gate fails; close the current browser-Qwen3 route without production integration.
decision_rule.continuation_if_pass: Build immutable full static shards and compact metadata; validate hashes and browser search before preparing any opt-in integration.

prohibitions: No production changes in this experiment.
No changes to src/core/rank.js or existing retrieval.
No human relevance labels, reranker or generative model.
No model weights committed to Git.
No modification of frozen FAISS, embeddings or prior benchmark artifacts.
No parameter changes after v4 execution begins.
